summary.one_line: The catalog and both mod installation guides match their public source repos and editorial page types.

purpose.evidence: Read all 17 changed documentationFiles, including docs/llms.txt. New RU/EN mods landing pages distinguish two experimental products and their different installation methods; the bank pair provides a source-build how-to; predictor pages add source build and disable steps. The diary records the migration with preservation and no-new-live-run limits. Both mod repositories and the pinned devkit are public according to parent CI results.

structure.evidence: The catalog is marked landing and links separate bank/predictor guides. Both bank and predictor installation guides are now marked how-to and provide prerequisites, exact commands, result checks, removal and limits, matching CONTRIBUTING's task-page shape. Nav, index, related pages and llms.txt link the new material in both languages.

specificity.evidence: Compared mod install commands with the reviewed mod READMEs: predictor uses git clone --recursive, x86 NMake/CMake Release, the DLL+loader pair and --game; bank uses clone --recursive, Python venv, pinned devkit requirements, H5_WORKSPACE/H5_GAME_DIR, --source build, existing-H5U deploy, --army-layout --control and owned rollback. Pages retain bank hash 824a14.../1215708-byte package, 19-title/12-Type/13-family caveat and earlier T1-T4 ranges. The catalog distinguishes UserMODs H5U from predictor DLL loading.

reproducibility.evidence: Parent reports both mod repos public and pushed, predictor CI 9 checks with one explicitly allowed absent-game oracle skip, bank CI 4 checks, local predictor 9 checks with EXE oracle and root 52 checks. Site build/check 8 Node/23 Python/41 HTML, 13 browser tests, 30 viewport checks and RU/EN Universe-footer checks passed. The pages give concrete install/remove procedures while saying neither extracted mod had a fresh post-migration live game launch. I did not run the game or recompile either mod in this review.

evidence.evidence: Reviewed mod source READMEs at their prior approved HEADs and checked the new pages against their exact commands and scope. The diary's 17-test partition (9 predictor/2 bank/6 private prototype) and later 4 bank checks follow the parent-provided migration evidence; C++ normalization, byte-identical H5U and no fresh live run are not escalated to gameplay proof. The primary h5lobby.com site was verified by parent as UniverseTeam's lobby; I did not independently verify VK/Boosty ownership or run a game.

applicability.evidence: The catalog and both guides target the pinned Heroes V Universe build, require hash checks, warn that current lobby installations may differ, and do not claim universal plugin APIs or bundled game assets. Predictor is its own native loader/DLL pair, bank reference needs H5U plus diagnostic --army-layout launch; combined use remains untested. Historical imp-cache visual checks are separated from current offline builds. The footer link labels Universe rather than presenting this personal knowledge base as official.

translations.evidence: Compared RU/EN mods catalog, bank how-to, predictor installation extension, migration diary and related links. Commands, hashes, 9/4/52 test counts, no-new-live-run caveat, pinned devkit revision, UserMODs distinction and two-product boundaries match. Both predictor pages now declare how-to in parallel; llms.txt adds canonical mod AGENTS links and nav/footer labels are localized.

maintenance.evidence: The new pages link canonical public mod repos and the pinned devkit rather than duplicating source files; llms.txt points to mod agent guides, and contextual backrefs connect bank/native UI/build information. The dated diary appends migration evidence and an initial missing-random-import failure rather than silently rewriting prior experiments. The final metadata correction changes both predictor pages from explanation to how-to, aligning future editorial acceptance with their installation task. review:info lists all 17 changed documentation paths.
